raw_text: Establish a purpose and goals for writing and identify a target audience. (C)
competency_statement: Set a clear purpose and goals for writing and identify who the writing is for.
observable_behaviors: State why they are writing a text.
Describe what they want to accomplish with their writing.
Name the intended readers or audience for their writing.
skill_clauses: Identify a target audience for writing.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Recognize the purpose and audience of a writing task when described.
student_actions.oral_production: Explain the purpose and audience for their writing orally.
student_actions.written_production: Write statements about the purpose and goals for their writing and identify the audience.
student_actions.procedural_application: Apply the process of setting a purpose and identifying an audience before writing.
student_actions.representation_modeling: Model setting a purpose and identifying an audience for writing.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain why setting a purpose and identifying an audience is important for writing.
